limitations: No actual APT update, unattended package transaction, systemd activation or Pi/ARM64 operation was executed by this reviewer.
Debian12/13 and Raspberry Pi keyring/source/maintainer-script behavior requires target acceptance; stable repositories may combine security and other fixes.
Node/npm exclusion applies to this EOS updater only. Host root, other timers, cron, manual APT or unrelated package tools remain outside this control; only the named distro timer is observed.
Graceful SIGINT and inherited lock probes do not establish uninterrupted real dpkg operation; power failure, OOM/MemoryMax and kernel termination can still interrupt package transactions.
Status is a time-stamped snapshot, not a continuously observed assertion. Failed status writes or timer changes can remain unseen until the freshness window or another observation.
SBOM covers actual installed dpkg rows when the updater runs, not npm, containers, EEPROM firmware or manual software.
No vulnerability exploit, independent pentest, CRA certification or production release acceptance is claimed.
EOS-HOST-REDIS-20261001 remains an installation blocker. No historical signed release or evidence was rewritten.
